findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The ice machine baffle was observed to have soil accumulation. The operator was informed and instructed to clean the baffle and maintain it free of soil buildup. Ensure the ice machine baffle is cleaned to sight and touch. The inspector will follow up on May 7, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [PF]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: No ambient thermometers was observed in the walk-in cooler. The operator informed the inspector that there is an ambient thermometer in the walk-in cooler but was unable to show the inspector during the inspection. The inspector instructed operator to ensure an internal thermometers is provided in the walk-in cooler to allow for proper temperature monitoring, especially in the event of equipment failure. Ensure ambient thermometers are placed in the warmest part of each cooler to accurately monitor internal temperatures.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit. [C]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Ants were observed crawling on the soiled floor under the shelf in the non-functional walk-in freezer. The inspector informed and instructed the operator to ensure the ants are removed from the facility. The inspector will follow-up on May 7, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Soil accumulation was observed on the floor under the shelf in the non-functional walk-in freezer. The inspector informed and instructed the operator to ensure the floor is cleaned to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(B) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. [C]
